name: nt-dev
description: Everyday development workflow: /nt-dev:pr writes a PR body against the org template, /nt-dev:cleanup audits a repo for drift, /nt-dev:md-format wraps and tidies markdown at a width you pick, /nt-dev:recall reads a prior session back into context, /nt-dev:issue writes a GitHub issue to the house standard, /nt-dev:eod-update writes a copy-paste end-of-day standup update from today's GitHub activity (never posts), and the Attentive output style trades asking for acting, then reports what changed.
